baseline_contribution: Before retrieval the frozen core already chose physical mirror, phone-holding and lantern-carrying hand roles, workshop repair, stitched seam, ruined paper, screen check and small relief. The new candidate clarifies operator ownership and shared reflected space; it did not originate the concept.
uninvoked_v1_contribution: sf_097 was adopted only in a preserved preflight-only V1 run. Actual calls were zero; that lens-directed refinement is absent from the V2 final prompt.
unselected_fitting_candidate: sf_096 screen-target gaze is compatible with the independently authored baseline screen check, but is not separately selected; no complete candidate contract is claimed from generic overlap.
profile_coverage_limit: New sf_091/sf_092/sf_178 profiles are exposed but not selected because face concealment or handheld mirror staging is less useful for the repair-and-relief frame. No new selfie profile hard gate is created.
pixel_boundary: Official gates are derived from the exact composed policy. Separate topic observations will inspect depicted capture ownership/reflection geometry; actual hardware activity and hidden phone-screen content cannot be proven from a still.

pixel_result.contribution_scope: Complete capture-owner/shared-reflection relation is literal in the final prompt and visibly supported in the returned image. The independent baseline already chose the mirror scene; no counterfactual improvement amount is established.
